resources.string: It\'s working - even if you can\'t see the camera.
%1$s scans in the background so checkout stays smooth. Aim at the code, wait a beat, and you\'re good.
Pay small amounts instantly - no extra taps.
Set a limit you\'re comfortable with. For anything above it, %1$s will ask before paying.
Connect the wallet you already use. %1$s focuses on fast in-person payments - everything else stays in your wallet.
Choose when %1$s should ask for confirmation before paying.

Using %1$s is at your own risk. This app connects to your own Lightning wallet - you are fully responsible for the funds in your wallet and any payments made.\n\nWe strongly recommend connecting wallets with small spending balances or using NWC connections with limited budgets.
You\'ll create a connection in your wallet and bring the connection string back to %1$s.
In your wallet, create a new NWC connection for %1$s.
Set a reasonable budget and enable payment permissions.
Scan the QR code or paste the connection string on the next screen.
